items.exampleEn: The growing number of tourists has made the old town noisy.
items.exampleZh: 越來越多的觀光客讓老城區變得很吵。

items.exampleEn: We are still waiting for the outcome of the interview.
items.exampleZh: 我們還在等面試的結果。

items.exampleEn: Hard work is ultimately more important than talent.
items.exampleZh: 說到底，努力比天分更重要。

items.exampleEn: Our family's circumstances changed when we moved to a bigger city.
items.exampleZh: 我們家搬到大城市後，生活情況改變了。

items.exampleEn: The meeting ended without any resolution of the problem.
items.exampleZh: 會議結束了，問題卻完全沒有解決。

items.exampleEn: Spring is a time of transition from cold to warm weather.
items.exampleZh: 春天是天氣由冷轉暖的過渡時期。

items.exampleEn: Our cat shows strong resistance to having a bath.
items.exampleZh: 我們家的貓非常抗拒洗澡。

items.exampleEn: My son is going through a phase where he asks 'why' about everything.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子正處在什麼事都要問「為什麼」的階段。

items.exampleEn: Two large companies dominate the market.
items.exampleZh: 兩家大公司主導這個市場。

items.sentenceEn: The first phase of the building work will finish in May.
items.sentenceZh: 建築工程的第一階段將在五月完成。

items.audioEn: Whatever the outcome of the game, let's have dinner together afterwards.
items.audioZh: 不管比賽結果如何，賽後我們一起吃晚餐吧。
items.questionZh: 說話者提議比賽後做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Under certain circumstances, you may work from home.
items.sentenceZh: 在某些情況下，你可以在家工作。

items.sentenceEn: Moving to a new city was a difficult transition for my children.
items.sentenceZh: 搬到新城市，對我的孩子們來說是很難的轉變。

items.stemEn: Despite strong ____ from local people, the city built the new road.
items.stemZh: 儘管當地居民強烈反對，市政府還是蓋了那條新路。

items.stemEn: Soccer used to ____ the sports news, but now basketball is just as popular.
items.stemZh: 足球以前主導體育新聞，但現在籃球也一樣受歡迎。

items.passageEn: When our company decided to move to a four-day work week, the transition was not easy. In the first phase, the plan met resistance from some managers, who believed that long hours were crucial to success. However, there was growing evidence from other companies that shorter weeks could work, so the managers agreed to a six-month test. Under the new circumstances, every team had to plan its time carefully, and meetings could no longer dominate the day. The outcome surprised everyone: sales stayed the same, and people took less sick leave. Ultimately, the company kept the plan. Many staff made a resolution to use their free Fridays for family and hobbies.
items.passageZh: 公司決定改成每週上班四天時，轉換的過程並不容易。在第一階段，這個計畫遭到一些經理反對，他們認為長時間工作是成功的關鍵。不過，越來越多其他公司的證據顯示，縮短工作週也行得通，於是經理們同意試行六個月。在新的情況下，每個團隊都得仔細規劃時間，會議也不能再佔據一整天。結果讓大家都很意外：業績維持不變，請病假的人也變少了。最終，公司保留了這個制度。很多員工下定決心，要把空出來的星期五留給家人和嗜好。

questions.questionZh: 一開始，有些經理為什麼反對？
options: 擔心客戶週五找不到人會打來抱怨
認為長時間工作是成功的關鍵
覺得員工放假多就會偷懶
業績大幅下滑，加班的人變多
業績不變，請病假的人變少
會議變得更多，下班時間更晚

items.promptZh: 最終，我們決定留在台北。
referenceEn: Ultimately, we decided to stay in Taipei.
We ultimately decided to stay in Taipei.
rubricZh: ultimately 表示「最終、到頭來」，可放句首或動詞前
寫 In the end、Finally 意思也對；時態合理即可（例如 decided、have decided）

items.promptZh: 我弟弟下定決心今年夏天學會游泳。
referenceEn: My younger brother made a resolution to learn to swim this summer.
My little brother has made a resolution to learn how to swim this summer.
rubricZh: resolution 在這裡指「決心」（例如 made a resolution to… 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 made、has made 等）
「學會游泳」可寫，例如 learn to swim、learn how to swim 等
